measurement: peak ion heat flux over t <= 100 against the unsheared run over the same window; none of the sheared cases saturates, so the growth phase is what is compared

suppressed_at_and_above.note: runs at 0.05, 0.1 and 0.2 decay from the seed without ever growing, so they carry no quench and are excluded

normalisation.stella: gamma_E = (r/q) (dOmega_zeta/dr) (a/v_th), shear of the angular rotation frequency
normalisation.module: gamma_E = |d(E_r/B)/dr| a/v_ti, shear of the linear drift velocity, carrying no geometric factor
normalisation.note: the conversion assumes v_E = R Omega_zeta and q = 1/iota, so alpha carries about a factor of two
